notes:
- Removed the old Python/PyInstaller backend and moved to a pure C# firmware engine inside the main program.
- Fixed download session and resume logic so BinaryInit and file downloads reuse the same FUS session.
- Fixed changelog parsing so only the current firmware version log is shown, no historical entries mixed in.
- Improved pause/cancel response so the current download request stops immediately.
- Improved auto-decrypt: existing ZIP files are safely replaced after successful decrypt instead of failing directly.
- Added optional multithread downloads with 2/4/6/8 Range connections; disabled by default for stability.
- Improved latest version and history detection: prefer Samsung SmartHistory, fall back to version.xml when unavailable.
